enrichment.headline: Adds $180,000 and a year to Bay Alarm's burglary alarm response and patrol services
enrichment.summary: This amendment lets Bay Alarm keep providing burglary alarm response and outside patrol, 24 hours a day, seven days a week. The contract limit rises from $45,000 to $225,000, and the end date moves from June 30, 2020 to June 30, 2021.

history.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
history.motion: A motion was made by Yee, seconded by Harris, to Approve the General Consent Report. The motion carried by the following vote

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, General Services Agreement between the District and Bay Alarm, Concord, CA, for the latter to continue to provide burglary alarm response and outside patrol services, 24 hours per day, seven days per week, as delineated in Exhibit A, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, in an additional amount of $180,000.00, increasing Agreement not to exceed amount from $45,000.00 to $225,000.00, extending term of Agreement from April 1, 2020 thru June 30, 2020 to June 30, 2021 and authorizing the President and Secretary of the Board to sign the Amendment for same with said Vendor. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
items.title: Amendment No. 1, General Services Agreement - Bay Alarm - District Response & Patrol Services Project - Police Services Department

attachments.name: 20-0661 Memorandum of Understanding and Engagement Policy - Fisher & Phillips LLC - General Counsel

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $50,000 for Fisher & Phillips to advise on work visas for teachers hired abroad
enrichment.summary: Law firm Fisher & Phillips LLC will provide immigration advice and prepare and file H-1B (specialty-occupation work visa) petitions for district teachers recruited abroad. The agreement runs March 1 through June 30, 2020, for no more than $50,000. Because the Board is ratifying it, the work began before approval.

history.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
history.motion: A motion was made by Yee, seconded by Harris, to Approve the General Consent Report. The motion carried by the following vote

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.text: Ratification by the Board of Education of the Memorandum of Understanding and Engagement Policy between the District and Fisher & Phillips LLC, Seattle, WA, for the latter to provide immigration advice and prepare and file H-1B petitions for District teachers recruited abroad, for the term March 1, 2020 through June 30, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $50,000.00.

attachments.name: 20-0745 Indemnification Agreement - District and Lighthouse Community Public Schools - Essential Governmental Function - Lodestar Charter School Project

enrichment.headline: Approves an indemnification agreement with Lighthouse Community Public Schools for the Lodestar project
enrichment.summary: The district and Lighthouse Community Public Schools sign an indemnification agreement tied to the district's designation of the Lodestar charter school project as an essential governmental function under Alameda County Health Officer Order No. 20-04. The text lists no dollar amount.
